# Create fake gene sequences

Create fake gene sequences

## Usage

``` r
ch_gene_sequence(n = 1, length = 30)
```

## Arguments

- n:

  (integer) number of things to get, any non-negative integer

- length:

  (integer) length of sequence to create

## See also

[SequenceProvider](https://docs.ropensci.org/charlatan/reference/SequenceProvider.md)

## Examples

``` r
ch_gene_sequence()
#> [1] "CGCAAAGACCTNCGGTGNACACCGNANCCT"
ch_gene_sequence(10)
```
